title: Teams Administrator Associate
note: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement. Pass mark on the real exam is 700. This boss uses 80 percent as a study gate.

questions.q: A user in Islands mode cannot use Direct Routing. What is the supported fix?
questions.explain: Direct Routing is not supported in Islands mode. The user has to be homed for Teams.

questions.q: Which license lets a person dial the PSTN through any of the four connectivity options?
questions.explain: Teams Phone is the user add-on. Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile, and Direct Routing are the connectivity choices.

questions.q: Where do you read one user's poor call, as opposed to a whole subnet?
questions.explain: Call Analytics is one user or one call. CQD is the building.

questions.q: Audio ports in the QoS article start at which range?
questions.explain: Audio 50000–50019 DSCP 46. Video starts at 50020. 5061 is SIP/TLS.

questions.q: A resource account for an auto attendant should carry which license?
choices: No license, because it cannot sign in
questions.explain: The resource account license is required even with no phone number. Do not assign the user phone license.

questions.q: Which FQDN can be paired as a Direct Routing SBC?
questions.explain: The SBC name must be on a verified domain. onmicrosoft.com is not eligible. The pstnhub names belong to Microsoft.

questions.q: Media bypass changes which path?
choices: The RTP path, when the design allows it
questions.explain: Signaling stays with Teams. Bypass is a media decision.

questions.q: What fails first when the certificate SAN is wrong?
questions.explain: A name mismatch fails before routing is interesting.

questions.q: Browser clients and the fixed QoS port ranges.
choices: Browser joins do not use those fixed ranges
Browsers mark DSCP 46 in every browser
Browsers open TCP 5061 to the SBC
questions.explain: The fixed ranges are for clients that can bind them. Browser joins are called out as different.

questions.q: Who must you be, together, to create a resource account?
choices: A Teams admin role and User Administrator
questions.explain: Create needs a Teams admin role plus User Administrator.

questions.q: A common-area phone on Direct Routing needs a Calling Plan.
choices: No. Direct Routing common-area phones do not need a Calling Plan
Only if media bypass is on
questions.explain: The phone system license and the connectivity model are different purchases.

questions.q: MS-700 on 14 October 2026.
choices: Still live, skills update on Oct 27 2026, not retired, no replacement
questions.explain: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement.

incident.title: London primary goes quiet after the certificate renewal
incident.brief: Users in London hear fast busy. Manchester still places PSTN calls. The change window renewed the London certificate an hour ago. This is a study incident, not a live SBC.
incident.syslog:
2026-10-14T14:02:11Z sbc-lon sip[2201]: OPTIONS from sip.pstnhub.microsoft.com:5061
2026-10-14T14:02:11Z sbc-lon tls[2201]: handshake fail peer=sip.pstnhub.microsoft.com alert=certificate_unknown reason=hostname mismatch SAN=sbc-lon.contoso.example presented=sbc-old.contoso.example
2026-10-14T14:02:41Z sbc-lon sip[2201]: OPTIONS miss count=3 trunk=London-Primary
2026-10-14T14:03:02Z teams-route: gateway sbc-lon.contoso.example marked unavailable
2026-10-14T14:03:05Z teams-route: failover candidate sbc-lon-b.contoso.example priority=2 result=not_on_route
2026-10-14T14:06:18Z sbc-man sip[884]: OPTIONS 200 OK peer=sip2.pstnhub.microsoft.com

steps.q: What failed first?
choices: TLS name check. The presented name is not the paired FQDN
CQD loss in the HQ subnet
steps.explain: The syslog stops at the handshake. SAN sbc-lon was paired. The certificate presented sbc-old. SIP never starts.

steps.q: London users fail and Manchester users do not. Why is that expected?
choices: Manchester uses a different Teams client build
Each gateway has its own certificate and route. Manchester is still answering OPTIONS
Media bypass is a country setting
Islands mode only applies in London
steps.explain: OPTIONS 200 from sbc-man shows that trunk is up. The London pair is the broken object.

steps.q: The failover line says the priority-2 gateway is not on the route. What do you change?
choices: Add the second London SBC to the voice route, then retest OPTIONS
Buy a Calling Plan for every user
steps.explain: A route with one gateway has nowhere to fail. Pair and list the second SBC before you call the design redundant.

steps.q: Which exam still covers this Teams admin work on 14 October 2026?
choices: MS-700, which is live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026, and is not retired
steps.explain: MS-700 is still live, with a skills update on Oct 27 2026; it is NOT retired and has no replacement.
